items.title: Bitmine edges toward 5% of ETH supply as treasuries report buys amid market slump
items.summary: Strategy, Strive, Bitmine and Cypherpunk disclosed fresh additions to their crypto treasuries, spanning Bitcoin, Ether and Zcash.

items.title: Boris Johnson says UK must lead blockchain development despite crypto doubts
items.summary: Johnson was joined by Lord Ross Kempsell who called for regulators to work with industry participants to bring the UK to the forefront.

items.title: Coinbase and Broadridge propose standard for tokenized stock disclosures
items.summary: The proposed standard aims to connect tokenized stockholders with corporate disclosures and voting materials across digital wallets, but would not create shareholder rights.

items.title: Nvidia turmoil tests Bitcoin miners? AI funding plans
items.summary: Nvidia?s leadership upheaval and Texas permit restrictions sharpen the divide between miners with funded projects and those still seeking capital and approvals.

items.title: Safe wallet reportedly loses $6.5M as Zodiac suspects key compromise
items.summary: Zodiac?s co-founder said a likely compromised key and overly permissive wallet settings enabled the theft, rather than a flaw in its smart contracts.

items.title: Bitcoin price fails to hold $65K as US stocks drop further on AI nerves
items.summary: Bitcoin and US equities saw pressure to start the week as traders weighed the impact of forthcoming Nvidia Q3 earnings and Anthropic?s IPO announcement.

items.title: Tom Lee Blames Nvidia and Anthropic IPO for Ethereum Plunge as Bitmine Buys the Dip
items.summary: The firm?s stash fell to $11.8 billion from $14.3 billion a week earlier as ETH slid 28% in two weeks, a ?waterfall? drop chairman Tom Lee blames on Nvidia fallout and cash-raising ahead of Anthropic?

items.title: Clarity Act Defeat ?Failure of American Leadership?: Trump?s Former Crypto Chief
items.summary: Former White House crypto chief Patrick Witt said the Clarity Act "lost against the clock," and regulators will now set the rules.

items.title: Trump Backs Jensen Huang?s Return to Nvidia as Sam Altman Says 'Heroes Have Flaws'
items.summary: Trump would welcome Nvidia?s co-founder back. Altman, who survived his own CEO ouster, sympathizes but stops short of endorsing Huang?s comeback.

items.title: Fed Is Modeling AI 'Super Intelligence' Scenarios, Including Job Losses and a Stock Market Slump
items.summary: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh says staff are studying three possible economic futures for AI, ranging from widespread productivity gains to higher unemployment and a painful correction in technology stocks.

items.title: Nvidia Stock Has a 20% Rebound in Sight?If Bulls Can Clear a Hurdle
items.summary: Nvidia shares tanked spectacularly last week amid the Jensen Huang scandal. Is it in for a major rebound? Here?s what the charts suggest.

items.title: Saylor?s Strategy Keeps Buying Bitcoin, Adding 'A Little Orange' Through the Dip
items.summary: The modest purchase lifted Strategy?s stash to 850,849 BTC as chairman Michael Saylor shrugged off a sharp downturn, posting that ?this dip could use a little orange.?

items.title: Democratic senators warn SEC?s tokenized stock exemption has illicit finance gaps
items.summary: Four Democratic senators are raising concerns about the Securities and Exchange Commission's newly unveiled innovation exemption.

items.title: Peraire-Bueno brothers acquitted of wire fraud in $25 million Ethereum MEV case
items.summary: A judge acquitted the Peraire-Bueno brothers of wire fraud over the Ethereum MEV exploit, ruling prosecutors showed no misrepresentation.

items.title: Bitwise sees Solana reaching $1,100 by 2031 in bull case as onchain trading grows
items.summary: Bitwise predicts the SOL token will be valued at $1,100 by 2031, versus $385 in the base case and $80 in the bear case.

items.title: Solflare CEO says AI security reviews are essential, touts ?bunker mode? and MoneyGram deal
items.summary: Vidor Gencel says AI catches chained exploits humans miss, and details the wallet's "bunker mode," privacy mode, and MoneyGram USDC cash-out.

items.title: Winklevoss-backed Cypherpunk buys Zcash dip as mining debut delivers $2.6 million operating profit
items.summary: Since quarter-end, Cypherpunk bought another 3,775 ZEC for about $3.5 million at an average price of $920.40.

items.title: Standard Chartered says Japan?s bond tokenization plans could help drive RWA market to $2 trillion
items.summary: Standard Chartered said Japan's bond tokenization plans could help the tokenized RWA market reach its $2 trillion forecast by 2028.

items.title: Lighter loses $15.5M in sudden drain and blames a single API leak
items.summary: Bitquery traced 10.39 million USDC off Lighter, while a second alleged loss and the recovery outcome remain unresolved.

items.title: XRP?s proposed upgrade could improve trading without boosting token demand
items.summary: New pool-pricing curves could improve execution, but additional XRP holding demand would depend on adoption, routing and persistent funding.

items.title: Jensen Huang has just 14% chance of Nvidia return this year despite Trump backing
items.summary: Prediction market traders see just a 14% chance of Jensen Huang returning to Nvidia before the end of 2026, despite mounting pressure to reinstate the company's ousted co-founder.

items.title: Bitcoin flashes false recovery warning as $64 billion futures frenzy masks weak demand
items.summary: The Friday-to-Monday decline establishes fewer open contracts in one segment, while sustained buying would strengthen the case for a lasting recovery.

items.title: Trezor patches crypto wallet spy chips but warns users a new device may not be enough
items.summary: Trezor says firmware 2.13.1 blocks identified implants, but CryptoBilis buyers covered by its warning still need new seeds and fund migration.

items.title: Kava moves to shut down lending platform after hackers drain nearly $4 million
items.summary: The November 14 reconstruction shows why blocking sale proceeds does not itself restore lenders access to their deposits.

items.title: Bitcoin risks falling below $60,000 as Nvidia earnings threaten to deepen crypto sell-off
items.summary: Rising bond yields, ETF outflows and forced selling are weighing on bitcoin as traders brace for more losses.

items.title: U.S. Senate Democrats tell CFTC to back off its demand prediction markets defy bans
items.summary: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission directed platforms such as Kalshi to defy state bans, but the Democrats want it to reverse course, citing court orders.

items.title: Lighter suspends all withdrawals after $10.4 million crypto exploit
items.summary: The decentralized exchange blamed a leaked trading API key and said its smart contracts were unaffected, while investigators traced funds to Hyperliquid.

items.title: Brazil's central bank faces backlash over stablecoin money laundering remarks
items.summary: A central bank official reportedly said legitimate funds become tainted when moved into stablecoins, comparing the market to the informal dolar-cabo system.

items.title: German parliament proposes crypto seizures without criminal charges
items.summary: German lawyers said a proposed law allowing the seizure of assets worth more than 100,000 euros could impose a burden of proof on crypto holders rather than the authorities.

items.title: Solana drops beta label after more than six years
items.summary: The blockchain is getting a shared version number. Wallets, transactions and apps remain unchanged.
